regions.summary: Weibei highland on the Jing River north of Xianyang: Bin, Xunyi, Changwu, Zhengning (Gansu), Chunhua.

candidates.name: Binzhou
candidates.meaning: Prefecture of Bin (the old Zhou homeland); in 725 the Tang changed the character 豳 to 邠 because it looked too like Youzhou (幽). Today's Binzhou is the county-level city at the same seat.
candidates.fit: Bin county is 29% of the region's people and all of it lies inside; the prefecture also held Xunyi, Changwu and Yongshou.
candidates.recognisability: Own zh-wiki articles (邠州, 彬州市), 498 hits with 陕西, top ones about this place.
candidates.source_note: 治新平县（今陕西彬县）；725年改豳州为邠州，沿袭至清末

candidates.name: Xunyi
candidates.meaning: Qin county name 栒邑, simplified to 旬邑 in 1964; known as the apple county.
candidates.fit: 23.7% of the region's people, whole county inside; second largest unit.
candidates.recognisability: Own zh-wiki article, county of Xianyang.
candidates.source_note: 战国时期的秦国初设栒邑县；1964年改称旬邑县

regions.notes: Pinyin Binzhou is identical to Binzhou (滨州) in Shandong; far away, but Anita should know.

regions.summary: Jing River plain north of the Wei: Jingyang county, northern Xianyang (Weicheng) and Gaoling.

candidates.name: Jingyang
candidates.meaning: "Sunny side of the Jing" (north bank); named in the Shijing (Xiaoya, Liuyue).
candidates.fit: 42% of the region's people, 99% of the county inside; seat Jinggan town is in the region.
candidates.recognisability: Own zh-wiki article, 733 hits with 陕西, top ones about this place.
candidates.source_note: 泾阳之名最早见于《诗·小雅·六月》

candidates.name: Weicheng
candidates.meaning: "Wei city": Han county that replaced Qin Xianyang at Yaodian, known from Wang Wei's Weicheng poem. Today a Xianyang district.
candidates.fit: Han Weicheng seat lay at Yaodian in today's Weicheng district; the region holds that district's eastern part (29% of people, with Zhouling and Zhengyang streets).
candidates.recognisability: Own zh-wiki articles (渭城县, 渭城区), 159 hits with 陕西; modest.
candidates.source_note: 汉武帝时改为渭城县（今咸阳渭城区窑店）

regions.notes: Qin Xianyang itself lay here (Yaodian), not at the modern Xianyang centre in region 7.

regions.summary: Wei plain northeast of Xi'an: Sanyuan, Gaoling, Yanliang and northern Lintong.

candidates.name: Sanyuan
candidates.meaning: "Three plains": named after the Mengou, Feng and Bailu plains around it; home of the Sanyuan merchants.
candidates.fit: Second largest unit (27% of people, 73% of the county inside) and the only whole county in a region of Yanliang, Gaoling and northern Lintong parts.
candidates.recognisability: Own zh-wiki article, 1004 hits with 陕西, top ones about this place.
candidates.source_note: 《元和郡县志》：以其地西有孟侯原，南曰丰原，北曰白鹿原，故名

candidates.name: Gaoling
candidates.meaning: "High mound", from the Fengzheng plain south of the town (Erya: a big mound is a ling).
candidates.fit: 17% of people; county was split with region 2, which holds 14% of its own people.
candidates.recognisability: Own zh-wiki article, now a Xi'an district.
candidates.source_note: 因县内有奉正原…取《尔雅》曰“大阜曰陵”，故名“高陵”

candidates.name: Lintong
candidates.meaning: "Overlooking the Tong (a stream)"; the Qin Terracotta Army district.
candidates.fit: Listed as 55% of people, but the units layer lumps Yanliang in; the Lintong centre, Mount Li and the Terracotta Army are in region 5.
candidates.recognisability: Very high, but it belongs to region 5.
candidates.source_note: 区人民政府驻骊山街道（在5号区）

regions.notes: Yueyang (Qin capital at Yanliang) fits historically but would clash with Yueyang in Hunan, so I left it out.

regions.summary: Qian and Liquan counties west of Xianyang, with part of Yongshou.

candidates.name: Qianzhou
candidates.meaning: Prefecture of Qian ("heaven", after Qianling, the tomb of Emperor Gaozong and Wu Zetian).
candidates.fit: Prefecture seated at Qian county, 53% of the region's people; Liquan was also under it in Tang and Song.
candidates.recognisability: Own zh-wiki article, 187 hits with 陕西; Qian county is known for Qianling.
candidates.source_note: 治所在奉天县（今陕西省乾县）；辖区约当今乾县、武功、周至、礼泉等县地

candidates.name: Liquan
candidates.meaning: "Sweet spring" (醴泉): a spring tasting like sweet wine welled up beside a Han palace; Taizong's Zhaoling tomb is here.
candidates.fit: 34% of people, 84% of the county inside.
candidates.recognisability: Own zh-wiki article, county of Xianyang.
candidates.source_note: 汉宣帝时涌出，其味如醴。隋置县取此

regions.summary: East of Xi'an: Lintong centre with the Terracotta Army, Mount Li, and the Baqiao district.

candidates.name: Lishan
candidates.meaning: "Black horse mountain", an outlier of the Qinling at Lintong with the Huaqing hot springs and Qin Shi Huang's tomb at its foot.
candidates.fit: Lintong streets (Qinling, Xinfeng, Lishan, Daiwang, Xiquan) are 54% of people and sit around the mountain.
candidates.recognisability: Own zh-wiki article, 283 hits with 陕西, top ones about this place.
candidates.source_note: 骊山位于西安市临潼区城区南侧…是秦岭北麓的山地

candidates.name: Lintong
candidates.meaning: "Overlooking the Tong"; the Tang Zhaoying county renamed Lintong in 1015.
candidates.fit: The district centre is here, though the region also holds the Baqiao part (about 40%) and the district's north is in region 3.
candidates.recognisability: Own zh-wiki article, the Terracotta Army district.
candidates.source_note: 区人民政府驻骊山街道

regions.notes: Lintong as a name is better known than Lishan. Either works; Lishan keeps the district name from covering the Baqiao half.

regions.summary: Northwest of Xi'an: Weiyang district's western streets, Han Chang'an city ruins, Jianzhang road, Caotan.

candidates.name: Jianzhang
candidates.meaning: Jianzhang Palace, the large Han detached palace of Emperor Wu just west of Han Chang'an.
candidates.fit: Jianzhang road street is 8% of people; the Han city ruins (Hancheng street, 20%) lie in the same region, and the palace sat just outside the city's southwest wall.
candidates.recognisability: Own zh-wiki article; modest outside Han history.
candidates.source_note: 建章宫是汉长安城在城外西南侧的一座离宫

candidates.name: Weiyang
candidates.meaning: "Not yet ended": the Han Weiyang Palace; today's Weiyang district, named after it.
candidates.fit: All eight streets of this region are Weiyang district streets, but the palace street itself and the district seat area sit in region 8.
candidates.recognisability: Own zh-wiki article for district and palace.
candidates.source_note: 名称由区内的汉未央宫而来

regions.notes: Weiyang is also offered for region 8. Use it in only one.

regions.summary: Xianyang urban core: Qindu district and southern Weicheng.

candidates.name: Xianyang
candidates.meaning: "Yang on all sides": north of the Wei river and south of Mount Jiuzong, both on the sunny side. The Qin capital.
candidates.fit: City rule: Xianyang's urban population is over 1M and this region holds the modern centre (Qindu and Weicheng streets, 92% of the region's people).
candidates.recognisability: Very high.
candidates.source_note: 山南曰阳，水北也称阳。咸阳地处九嵕山之南，渭水之北，山水俱阳

regions.notes: The Qin capital's ruins are around Yaodian, in region 2.

regions.summary: North side of Xi'an inside the ring road: Weiyang Palace, Daming Palace, Beiguan, Zhangjiabao.

candidates.name: Weiyang
candidates.meaning: "Not yet ended": the Han emperors' main palace in Chang'an, built from 200 BC.
candidates.fit: Weiyang Palace street is 31% of people and holds the palace ruins; the region also has Weiyang district's seat area.
candidates.recognisability: Own zh-wiki article, 182 hits with 陕西, top ones about this place.
candidates.source_note: 未央宫是汉长安城的主要宫殿，遗址位于今西安市未央区

candidates.name: Daming
candidates.meaning: "Great brightness": Tang Daming Palace (Eastern Inner Court), the main imperial residence from Gaozong on.
candidates.fit: Daming Palace street is 26% of people and holds the palace site.
candidates.recognisability: Own zh-wiki article, 744 hits with 陕西; but plain "Daming" is also a county in Hebei (大名).
candidates.source_note: 大明宫又称东内，为唐长安城东北部的宫城

regions.notes: Both palaces are in this region; Weiyang is also on the list for region 6.

regions.summary: Wei plain west of Xianyang: Xingping, Wugong, Yangling and a slice of Qindu.

candidates.name: Xingping
candidates.meaning: "Rising peace": renamed after the Xingping army camped there in the An Lushan rebellion.
candidates.fit: 53% of people, 98% of the county-level city inside.
candidates.recognisability: Own zh-wiki article, county-level city of Xianyang.
candidates.source_note: 因平乱有功的兴平军驻扎此地，遂改名“兴平县”，并沿用至今

candidates.name: Maoling
candidates.meaning: Tomb of Emperor Wu of Han, and the Han county built around it.
candidates.fit: The tomb is in Xingping; the Han Maoling county (139 BC to 219) lay in the region's largest unit.
candidates.recognisability: Own zh-wiki article, 350 hits with 陕西, top ones about this place.
candidates.source_note: 位于咸阳市区与兴平市之间的五陵塬

candidates.name: Wugong
candidates.meaning: "Martial merit", an old Han county name.
candidates.fit: 32% of people, 77% of the county inside.
candidates.recognisability: Own zh-wiki article, but pinyin Wugong reads as the martial-arts word.
candidates.source_note: 武功县是咸阳市所辖的一个县

regions.summary: Small sliver west of Xi'an's old city: Zaoyuan, Tumen and Taoyuanlu streets in Lianhu district.

candidates.name: Zaoyuan
candidates.meaning: "Jujube garden": a Lianhu subdistrict (and a village name on the Han city's south side).
candidates.fit: Zaoyuan is 46% of the region's people.
candidates.recognisability: Own zh-wiki article for the Xi'an street, but the Zaoyuan in Yan'an is far better known.
candidates.source_note: 枣园街道隶属西安市莲湖区；下辖汉城北路社区等

candidates.name: Lianhu
candidates.meaning: "Lotus lake", after the Lianhu park; the district's name.
candidates.fit: All three streets belong to Lianhu district, but most of that district's 1M people are in region 11.
candidates.recognisability: Own zh-wiki article.
candidates.source_note: 由莲湖公园而得名；常住人口约102万人

regions.notes: A 166k sliver with no obvious historical or natural name. Weak options; Anita may prefer to pick by hand.

regions.summary: Xi'an's walled old city and inner ring: Beilin, Lianhu and Xincheng cores.

candidates.name: Xi'an
candidates.meaning: "Western peace": the Ming name for the city (formerly Chang'an).
candidates.fit: City rule: the most central region, holding the Ming city wall streets (Beilin, Beiyuanmen, Zhongshanmen).
candidates.recognisability: Very high.
candidates.source_note: 西安主城区至今仍保留有完整的明代城墙及城门

regions.summary: East and southeast of the old city: Qujiang, Dayanta, Dengjiapo, Hansenzhai, Shilipu.

candidates.name: Qujiang
candidates.meaning: "Winding river": the Tang imperial pleasure pool and park, now the Qujiang new area.
candidates.fit: Qujiang street is 13% of people, Dayanta and Dengjiapo (also Yanta) another 24%.
candidates.recognisability: Own zh-wiki article, 809 hits with 陕西, top ones about this place.
candidates.source_note: 曲江新区属于雁塔区，位于西安城东南

candidates.name: Yanta
candidates.meaning: "Wild goose pagoda": the Big Wild Goose Pagoda, the district's name.
candidates.fit: The pagoda street and Dengjiapo are in the region; the district's other streets are in region 13.
candidates.recognisability: Own zh-wiki article, 468 hits with 陕西.
candidates.source_note: 名称由著名的大雁塔而来

regions.notes: Yanta is also the district of region 13, but only region 12 holds the pagoda.

regions.summary: South of the old city: Changyanbao, Zhangbagou, Dianzicheng, Xiaozhai (Gaoxin area).

candidates.name: Xiaozhai
candidates.meaning: "Small stockade": the south-city commercial and university hub of Xi'an, and the old seat of Yanta district.
candidates.fit: Xiaozhai road street is 11% of people; the region is the southern Yanta streets and the Gaoxin zone around it.
candidates.recognisability: Own zh-wiki article, 237 hits with 陕西, but several are about the Lantian Xiaozhai.
candidates.source_note: 区人民政府驻小寨东路168号

candidates.name: Yanta
candidates.meaning: "Wild goose pagoda": the Big Wild Goose Pagoda, the district's name.
candidates.fit: All five streets are in Yanta district, but the pagoda itself is in region 12.
candidates.recognisability: Own zh-wiki article.
candidates.source_note: 名称由著名的大雁塔而来

regions.summary: West and southwest of Xi'an: western Chang'an district, Doumen, Qindu on the Feng, Hu's east.

candidates.name: Haojing
candidates.meaning: Capital of the Western Zhou founded by King Wu, on the east bank of the Feng River.
candidates.fit: The ruins are at Doumen (Doumen street, 8% of people) and in the Chang'an streets that are 64% of the region.
candidates.recognisability: Own zh-wiki article (鎬京), 54 hits with 陕西, less than the Fenghao pair.
candidates.source_note: 镐京位于沣河东岸，为周武王所建

candidates.name: Fenghao
candidates.meaning: Feng and Hao, the twin Western Zhou capitals either side of the Feng River.
candidates.fit: Both sites lie within or beside the region (Feng on the west bank in the Fengxi side, Hao at Doumen).
candidates.recognisability: Own zh-wiki article, national heritage site.
candidates.source_note: 丰京位于今西安市西南沣河西岸…镐京位于沣河东岸

candidates.name: Chang'an
candidates.meaning: "Perpetual peace": the capital's name since Han, and today's district.
candidates.fit: 64% of people, but only 31% of the district; the seat Weiqu is in region 15, which takes the name.
candidates.recognisability: Very high.
candidates.source_note: 区人民政府驻地韦曲街道

regions.summary: Weiqu and Guodu, the Chang'an district seat south of the old city.

candidates.name: Chang'an
candidates.meaning: "Perpetual peace": Han capital name and today's Xi'an district; the old Chang'an county seat was Weiqu.
candidates.fit: 73% of people, Weiqu (the district seat and old county seat) is 43% of the region.
candidates.recognisability: Very high; own zh-wiki article for the district.
candidates.source_note: 区人民政府驻地韦曲街道；公元前202年，西汉设立长安县

regions.notes: Only one good candidate; Chang'an is also the name of the whole old city, so Anita may prefer it elsewhere. Region 14 and 16 hold other parts of the district.

regions.summary: Southeast: Lantian county, Bailuyuan plain, eastern Chang'an district and Baqiao south.

candidates.name: Lantian
candidates.meaning: "Blue field": the source of Lantian jade, and of Lantian Man (about 1.5M years old).
candidates.fit: 47% of people, 99% of the county inside, 69% of the area.
candidates.recognisability: Own zh-wiki article, one of the four famous jades.
candidates.source_note: 古时以盛产蓝田玉闻名；境内有蓝田猿人遗址

candidates.name: Bailuyuan
candidates.meaning: "White deer plain": the plateau between the Ba and Chan rivers; also the title of Chen Zhongshi's novel.
candidates.fit: Hongqi and Dizhai streets (Baqiao) and the Chang'an east streets lie on the plain; the Lantian county is mostly mountain beyond it.
candidates.recognisability: Own zh-wiki article, 159 hits with 陕西; novel and film are famous.
candidates.source_note: 位于西安市东南方向10公里，灞河和浐河之间

regions.summary: Southwest foothills of the Qinling: Hu (Huyi) district, Zhouzhi county, southwest Chang'an.

candidates.name: Zhongnan
candidates.meaning: "South end": the Zhongnan mountains, the Qinling stretch behind Xi'an, a hermit and Daoist centre.
candidates.fit: Zhongnan town, Louguan and Caotang lie in the region, 15% of its people; the mountains form its whole southern edge.
candidates.recognisability: Own zh-wiki article, 240 hits with 陕西, top ones about this place.
candidates.source_note: 一般指秦岭山脉中段陕西省境内，西起武功县，东到蓝田县的部分

candidates.name: Zhouzhi
candidates.meaning: "Winding of mountains and rivers" (盩厔), simplified in 1964 to a homophone.
candidates.fit: 40% of people, 70% of the county inside, 40% of the area.
candidates.recognisability: Own zh-wiki article.
candidates.source_note: 盩厔的意思是“山川曲折”，因“山曲为盩，水曲为厔”而得名

candidates.name: Huyi
candidates.meaning: Named after the Hu tribe (有扈氏) of the Xia; Hu county, renamed Hu in 1964 and Huyi in 2016.
candidates.fit: 45% of people, 80% of the district inside; the largest unit.
candidates.recognisability: Own zh-wiki article; barely known outside Shaanxi.
candidates.source_note: 夏朝为“有扈氏”部落…2016年撤县改区，恢复鄠字
